entities.name: Cătălin Drulă
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cătălin Drulă is a Romanian politician who served as the president of the Save Romania Union (USR) political party, until his resignation in 2024, and as an incumbent member of the Romanian Chamber of Deputies, elected as a deputy for Timiș County at the 2020 Romanian legislative election.
